blocks.content: Course: API Handling with Asynchronous Javascript
As mentioned before, the await keyword pauses function execution until the promise resolves. For example,
When JavaScript hits the first await, it:

items: Pauses the function at that line.
Waits for the promise to resolve.
Resumes execution with the resolved value.

blocks.content: Obviously, await pauses your function without pausing JavaScript — everything else still runs. The UI stays responsive. Events still fire.
